description_en: Modifies the name of an endpoint that is associated with a basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用UpdateBasicEndpoint接口修改基础型全球加速实例的终端节点名称
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-basic-endpoint --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --endpoint-id ep-bp14sz7ftcwwjgrdm0000 --name ep01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateBasicEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint that you want to modify belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的基础型全球加速实例终端节点所属的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint that you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的基础型全球加速实例终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the endpoint that is associated with the basic GA instance.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例终端节点的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoints belong
EndpointGroupId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例终端节点所属的终端节点组ID

EndpointId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例终端节点ID

Name.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例终端节点的名称
